verdict.rationale: Verbatim guidance text was retrieved from both public reading surfaces, irs.gov/payments/eftps and eftps.gov/eftps/, which implies they serve readable content without a bot wall, CAPTCHA, or JS-only shell. Probes against eftps.gov returned ordinary HTTP 404s rather than challenge or block pages, further suggesting the server answers keyless automated requests. The only gate documented is Login.gov/ID.me MFA, and it applies to the payment account, not the public pages. missing for 10: an explicit probe recording the HTTP status and user agent for the guidance pages themselves, confirmation that the content renders without JavaScript, and a published robots.txt crawl policy (robots.txt returns 404).
